user_request_original:
Execute a deterministic TMM optimization for a planar stack with the topology: Incident Medium (Air, n=1.0) | Layer 1 (TiO2, n=2.40, lossless) | Layer 2 (SiO2, n=1.46, lossless) | Substrate (Glass, n=1.52, lossless). Optimize the thicknesses of Layer 1 and Layer 2, constrained between 40 nm and 160 nm inclusive. The objective is to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence (0 degrees) over the wavelength range 450 nm to 700 nm, sampled every 5 nm. Use a deterministic optimizer with seed 17 and a maximum of 64 solver evaluations. Report the full spectrum, optimal thicknesses, and the calculated mean reflectance. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization s. wavelength intervals 450-700 nm. soft objectives: minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance from 450 to 700 nm; achieve mean reflectance below 0.03 as a soft scoring preference. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the 450 to 700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm; exactly one layer of SiO2 and one layer of TiO2.

Immutable original user request (overrides conflicting route proposals):
Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.
Preserve its physical constraints. Performance targets remain soft objectives.
